Hi Lila,

Thanks again for partnering with Redwood for the embedding project. To get AP setup and generate a PO I need a quick vendor intake packet from you. Can you please provide the following items by EOD Wednesday (1/20)?

- Completed W-9 (if US entity) or W-8BEN-E (if non-US)

Thanks — feel free to reply here or send to accounts-payable@redwood.com

Best,
